La=np.array(L); Ra=np.array(R); Oa=np.array(O)

ops=[]
for k in range(4):
 t=np.rot90(Ra,k)
 for f in [False,True]:
  x=np.fliplr(t) if f else t
  pred=(La==0)&(x==0)
  acc=(pred==Oa).mean()
  ops.append((acc,k,f,int(pred.sum()),int(np.sum(pred & Oa)),int(np.sum((~pred)&Oa))))
